BiblicalUsage: Ichabod is the name a dying mother gave her son when the ark was taken. In 1 Samuel 4:21 she names the child Ichabod, saying, the glory is departed from Israel, because the ark of God was taken, and in 1 Samuel 14:3 Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, wears the ephod before the people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name is the saddest in the Bible: a child named for the glory that left, on the day the ark was taken and his father and grandfather died.
RelatedEvents: The Ark Captured and Returned; Jonathan's Victory at Michmash
